text.p: Settings for the $PNAME API, which allows for other tools to interact with $PNAME.
Check "Start API Connection on Startup" to start the API connection directly when starting $PNAME.
Use the Host and Port sections to select what host and port to use. Leave host blank to use localhost.
$PNAME support both XML and JSON formats, select the appropriate one.
text.note: Normally when the API is used $PNAME will be launched by the other application. When it is, the Host, Port, and Type settings are overridden.
text.p: Check "Reconnect if Disconnected" to have the API try to reconnect if the other end disconnects.
Check "Ask on Trace Received" to always get a message box if a new trace is sent over the API.
